name: Nagydém (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of five stripes alternating green and white, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Nagydém: a red and white shield with a church, a wreath and a cross, with a yellow ring crest, above a scroll inscribed NAGYDÉM.
history: Nagydém consecrated its arms and flag in 1997, marking its independence after long being attached to other villages. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagydém arms with crest and scroll
